summary: FND-03 PostgreSQL schema and migrations: comprehensive DDL in database/migrations/0001_initial.sql covering all 21 Flowboard entities with strict foreign keys, ON DELETE RESTRICT on active columns, ON DELETE CASCADE on child items, DATE due dates, BIGINT ranks, JSONB changes/payloads, and performance indexes. Automated TypeScript runner with advisory locking (pg_advisory_lock) and transaction wrapping. All 7 relational integrity tests passed; independently audited and scored 10.0/10.0.
limitations: Verified against local PostgreSQL 17.11 container; remote poolers (Hyperdrive/Neon) evaluated in deployment stages.
Forward-only migrations; down-migrations are not implemented per project forward-only policy.

evidence.command: npm run typecheck && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false node --test apps/api/test/migrations.test.ts
evidence.result: Strict typecheck passed with 0 errors; 7 integration tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Independent audit rating: 10.0 / 10.0.
evidence.environment: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, Node 24.15.0, npm 11.12.1, PostgreSQL 17.11 Alpine official digest.
